submission.name: TrailTalk
submission.tagline: A pocket audio guide that narrates the places you pass on a walk.
submission.inspiration: We wanted to make local walks more interesting for people who do not want to keep checking a map or reading plaques. A spoken guide seemed like a good fit for visitors exploring a campus or neighborhood at their own pace.
submission.what_it_does: TrailTalk is a mobile friendly guide that plays short spoken descriptions for stops along a walking route. Pick a route and a narration style, then the app uses nearby stop information to generate commentary and reads it with an ElevenLabs voice. The route and audio are connected through a lightweight web view, so you can keep listening while you walk.
submission.how_we_built_it: We built the interface in React and used the browser location and map view to show a small set of stops. An Express backend receives the selected stop and its notes, then calls Gemini through OpenRouter to write a concise narration. The backend passes that text to ElevenLabs and returns the audio for playback, which keeps the API keys away from the phone UI. Our Python helper handles transcript and stop data prep for the demo.
submission.challenges_we_ran_into: Getting the narration and audio ready quickly enough for a walk was tricky because the services respond at different speeds. Location updates can also jump around, so the app sometimes selects a nearby stop unexpectedly. Our current routes have a small hand-entered set of places, and the experience can fail if an API call times out.
submission.accomplishments: We connected stop selection, generated narration, and voice playback into a working demo. We are happy with how ElevenLabs makes short descriptions feel like an actual guide instead of another block of text.
submission.what_we_learned: We learned how much audio timing affects a mobile experience: even a good voice feels awkward if it arrives too late. Gemini helped us vary the narration, while we learned to give it compact stop notes so it would stay focused and brief.
submission.whats_next: We would cache audio for common stops, improve location handling, and let local groups add their own route notes. We would also test more narration styles and add a clear way to pause or replay a stop while walking.
